description: Reviewed difference classes between astgen 1.10.6 (TypeScript 6) type maps and the native binary (TypeScript 7). A class not listed here fails lib/typemap/diff.mjs, and so does a class over its maxShare (its share of all keys, one and a half times the largest share seen on the corpus in parsetools-native.corpus.json). Normalizations live in lib/typemap/canon.mjs with their own tests and need no entry. different:unclassified can never be listed.

classes.reason: TypeScript 6 wrote a type alias by name (HttpInterceptorFn) where TypeScript 7, given the same InTypeAlias flag, writes its expansion. Dropping the flag or preferring alias names lowered agreement on every project measured (bulletproof-react 97.5 to 92.1 percent), so the flag stays.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: One side mentions `any` and the other does not, in a shape the refines-any classes cannot line up. Mostly TypeScript 7 resolving a library type TypeScript 6 left as any.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: TypeScript 6 had a type where the native binary has `any` in that position. Mostly in compiled and minified JavaScript; reviewed on juice-shop's build output.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: The native type has fewer `any` than the baseline and keeps every other name in it: more precise, in a shape where an `any` became a union.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: The native type is the baseline with an `any` replaced by a type (`Promise<any>` against `Promise<User>`): TypeScript 7 knows more.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: The native type is the baseline with an `unknown` replaced by a type (`Observer<unknown>` against `Observer<boolean>`).
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: typescript-go returns no type for the identifier of a type reference, so the identifier takes the type of its enclosing reference (getTypeFromTypeNode): `Promise<any>` where TypeScript 6 kept the declared `Promise<T>`. The reference itself is typed identically.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: A conditional or mapped type left unevaluated on one side (infer, [P in K]) and evaluated on the other: the checkers stop evaluating at different points.

classes.reason: The same object members keyed by enum members (`[TeamPreference.SeamlessEdit]`) in TypeScript 7 and by their values in TypeScript 6.
classes.reviewer: AI agent review of the corpus run, 2026-11-03

classes.reason: The same type reached through another import path to the same module (a package entry against its file, `sequelize/types/utils` against `sequelize/lib/utils`). TypeScript 7 resolves package entry points through `exports` and writes the path it reached.
